en-US.name: Smart Helper
en-US.summary: Talk to an AI model through your Echo.
en-US.description: A personal Alexa skill that answers open questions with a large language model and can search the web for current information.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask smart helper who invented the radio
Alexa, ask smart helper what's the tallest building in the world

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Personal use. Requires lambda/config.py with an LLM API key.
